tweaks.title: System restore point
tweaks.description: Recommended before making changes. Requires administrator rights and System Protection turned on.

tweaks.title: Windows Game Mode
tweaks.description: Windows limits background tasks and updates while you play.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off background recording (Game DVR)
tweaks.description: Turns off Xbox Game Bar DVR, which can load the GPU and lower FPS.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Power plan: High performance
tweaks.description: The CPU doesn't lower its clock speed during games. On laptops this raises power draw and temperatures.
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures, shorter battery life.

tweaks.title: Minimum processor state 100%
tweaks.description: The CPU runs at full clock speed at all times, which reduces micro-stutter. Higher temperature and power draw (on AC power).
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Game scheduling priority (MMCSS)
tweaks.description: Raises the priority of "Games" tasks for CPU/GPU and reduces resources reserved for multimedia.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (HAGS)
tweaks.description: Reduces CPU load during rendering. Depends on your GPU and driver: if you see artifacts or FPS drops, undo it.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Fortnite: no fullscreen optimizations + high-performance GPU
tweaks.description: Same as ticking "Disable fullscreen optimizations" in the game file's properties and choosing the high-performance GPU in Graphics settings.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off background apps
tweaks.description: Fewer background processes and lower CPU and RAM usage.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off transparency and window animations
tweaks.description: A lighter desktop and slightly less work for the GPU outside games.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision". Fortnite uses raw input, so this mainly gives consistent mouse movement outside the game and in menus.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Sticky / Filter Keys shortcuts
tweaks.description: Pressing Shift rapidly in-game (e.g. sprinting with macros) no longer opens a Windows dialog.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off USB port power saving
tweaks.description: Your mouse and keyboard aren't put to sleep, so there's no delay after a short idle period (on AC power).
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Turn off PCIe power saving
tweaks.description: The graphics card and NVMe drives don't enter low-power states, which reduces latency spikes (on AC power).
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Turn off network throttling
tweaks.description: Windows stops limiting the rate of network packet processing during media playback.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off update sharing (P2P)
tweaks.description: Windows doesn't upload updates to other PCs, so your connection isn't used in the background.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Flush DNS cache
tweaks.description: Removes stale DNS entries. Useful when you have trouble connecting to servers.

tweaks.title: Clean temporary files
tweaks.description: Deletes files from the user and Windows Temp folders. Files in use by running programs are skipped.
tweaks.confirm: Delete temporary files from the user and Windows Temp folders?

tweaks.title: Empty Recycle Bin
tweaks.description: Permanently deletes the contents of the Recycle Bin on all drives.
tweaks.confirm: Permanently empty the Recycle Bin on all drives? This can't be undone.

tweaks.title: Startup apps
tweaks.description: Opens Startup settings. Turn off anything you don't need at boot.

tweaks.title: Windows graphics settings
tweaks.description: Opens per-app GPU settings (high-performance GPU selection, HAGS).

tweaks.title: Task Manager
tweaks.description: See what's using the CPU, disk and network before you play.

tweaks.title: Turn off Xbox Game Bar
tweaks.description: Disables the startup panel and the Win+G shortcut, so fewer processes run while you play.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows suggestions and ads
tweaks.description: Turns off promoted apps and suggestions in the Start menu and on the lock screen (fewer background tasks).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off taskbar widgets and chat
tweaks.description: Hides the Widgets and Chat buttons (Windows 11) so they don't load in the background.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Visual effects: best performance
tweaks.description: Sets "Adjust for best performance" and turns off showing window contents while dragging.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off CPU core parking
tweaks.description: All cores stay active (on AC power), which reduces latency under sudden load.
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Aggressive processor boost
tweaks.description: The CPU ramps up its clock speed faster. Higher temperatures and power draw; this setting is unavailable on some PCs.
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Turn off fullscreen optimizations globally
tweaks.description: System-wide equivalent of "Disable fullscreen optimizations" for all games.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
tweaks.description: Fixes screen flicker and stutter on some graphics cards (mainly NVIDIA). Use it only if you have these symptoms.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Stops preloading programs into RAM. Usually unnecessary on an SSD; on an HDD it may slow program launches. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows Search indexing
tweaks.description: Less background disk activity. File search in Explorer will be slower. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Turn off telemetry service (DiagTrack)
tweaks.description: Windows stops sending diagnostic data in the background. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: No reports are sent after program crashes. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Limit telemetry (policy)
tweaks.description: Sets the lowest telemetry level allowed for your Windows edition (Home/Pro have a minimum limit anyway).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Foreground program priority
tweaks.description: Windows gives the foreground app longer CPU time slices (Win32PrioritySeparation = 38). The effect is usually small.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Fastest key repeat
tweaks.description: Minimum delay and maximum keyboard repeat rate.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Pointer speed 6/11 (1:1)
tweaks.description: The default Windows cursor speed, with no multipliers. Consistent sensitivity outside games.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: No menu delay
tweaks.description: Shows context menus instantly (MenuShowDelay = 0).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Faster mouse tooltips
tweaks.description: Shortens the hover time before tooltips appear.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Disk never sleeps
tweaks.description: The disk doesn't power down when idle, so there's no delay on the next access (AC power).
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Global timer resolution (Windows 11)
tweaks.description: Restores the behavior where high timer resolution applies system-wide, not only to the process that requests it. Windows 11 only; increases power draw.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Mouse Keys shortcut
tweaks.description: Disables the Alt+Left Shift+NumLock shortcut, which could pop up a dialog during a game.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off system notifications
tweaks.description: No pop-up notifications that could interrupt your game.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off USB selective suspend (system)
tweaks.description: Disables USB port suspend at the driver level, so your mouse and keyboard are always active.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off touch keyboard and handwriting service
tweaks.description: Unnecessary on a PC without a touch screen. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Turn off TCP packet delay (Nagle)
tweaks.description: Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 on active adapters. This affects TCP, and Fortnite mainly uses UDP, so the in-game effect may be negligible.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
tweaks.description: If your provider's IPv6 route is slower, connections go over IPv4 instead (DisabledComponents = 32).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Remove QoS limit (20%)
tweaks.description: Sets NonBestEffortLimit = 0. The effect is minimal, since the limit only applies to apps that request QoS.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off LLMNR (name broadcasting)
tweaks.description: Less unnecessary broadcast traffic on the local network and a lower risk of spoofing.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off NetBIOS over TCP/IP
tweaks.description: Stops broadcasting the computer name over NetBIOS on active adapters. May affect older network shares.
tweaks.consequences: Can break file sharing, network printers and name lookups on a home or office network. Gives no gaming or Internet speed gain.

tweaks.title: Turn off automatic Store app downloads
tweaks.description: Microsoft Store doesn't download app updates in the background while you play.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off OneDrive sync
tweaks.description: OneDrive stops syncing files, so it doesn't use your connection in the background. Reversible.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Wi-Fi: maximum performance mode
tweaks.description: The Wi-Fi adapter doesn't save power at the cost of latency (AC power). Playing over a cable is still best.
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Turn off background map downloads
tweaks.description: The Windows maps service stops downloading data in the background. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Turn off location service
tweaks.description: Fewer background location requests. Reversible (restores the previous startup type).
tweaks.consequences: Features that depend on this service will stop working until the previous startup type is restored.

tweaks.title: Reset Winsock
tweaks.description: Restores the Winsock catalog to its defaults. Helps with strange connection errors. Requires a restart.
tweaks.confirm: Reset Winsock? You'll need to restart your PC afterwards.

tweaks.title: Reset TCP/IP stack
tweaks.description: Restores TCP/IP stack settings (netsh int ip reset). Requires a restart.
tweaks.confirm: Reset the TCP/IP stack? Custom IP settings will be lost and you'll need to restart your PC.
tweaks.successMessage: TCP/IP stack reset. Restart your PC.

tweaks.title: Renew IP address
tweaks.description: Releases and renews the DHCP address. The connection will drop briefly.
tweaks.confirm: Renew the IP address? Your internet connection will drop briefly.

tweaks.title: Flush ARP table
tweaks.description: Removes cached device addresses on the local network.

tweaks.title: Flush NetBIOS name cache
tweaks.description: Reloads the remote NetBIOS name cache (nbtstat -R).

tweaks.title: Clean Prefetch
tweaks.description: Deletes files that speed up program launches. Windows rebuilds them itself; the first launches may be slightly slower.

tweaks.title: Clean thumbnail and icon cache
tweaks.description: Deletes the thumbnail cache in Explorer (locked files are skipped).

tweaks.title: Clean downloaded Windows updates
tweaks.description: Deletes files in SoftwareDistribution\Download. Windows downloads them again when needed.

tweaks.title: Clean shader cache (DirectX/NVIDIA/AMD)
tweaks.description: Deletes compiled shaders. The first game launch afterwards may load longer and stutter briefly.
tweaks.confirm: Clean the shader cache? The first game launch afterwards will load longer.

tweaks.title: Clean Fortnite logs and crash reports
tweaks.description: Deletes only the Logs and Crashes folders. Game settings (Config) are left untouched.

tweaks.title: Clean Epic Games Launcher cache
tweaks.description: Deletes the launcher's webcache and logs. The launcher recreates them on next start.
tweaks.confirm: Close Epic Games Launcher before cleaning. Continue?

tweaks.title: Clean crash dumps
tweaks.description: Deletes CrashDumps, Minidump and MEMORY.DMP files, which can take up gigabytes.

tweaks.title: Clean Windows error reports
tweaks.description: Deletes the Windows Error Reporting (WER) queue and archive.

tweaks.title: Clean browser cache (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)
tweaks.description: Deletes only the cache, not passwords or cookies. Close your browsers before cleaning.
tweaks.confirm: Close your browsers before cleaning. Continue?

tweaks.title: Clear recent files list
tweaks.description: Deletes the history of recently opened files and taskbar jump lists.
tweaks.confirm: Clear the recent files list and jump lists?

tweaks.title: Clean Delivery Optimization cache
tweaks.description: Deletes update files kept for sharing with other PCs.

tweaks.title: Clean CBS and Windows Update logs
tweaks.description: Deletes large system servicing log files.

tweaks.title: Reset Microsoft Store cache
tweaks.description: Runs wsreset.exe, which clears the Store cache and reopens the Store.

tweaks.title: Clear clipboard
tweaks.description: Deletes the clipboard contents.

tweaks.title: Disk Cleanup
tweaks.description: The classic Windows tool for removing unneeded files.

tweaks.title: Resource Monitor
tweaks.description: Detailed CPU, memory, disk and network usage.

tweaks.title: System Information
tweaks.description: Full description of your hardware and system (msinfo32).

tweaks.title: DirectX Diagnostic Tool
tweaks.description: Check your graphics card, driver and DirectX version.

tweaks.title: Optimize Drives
tweaks.description: HDD defragmentation and SSD TRIM.

tweaks.title: Device Manager
tweaks.description: Update drivers and check for device errors.

tweaks.title: Windows Services
tweaks.description: View and manage system services.

tweaks.title: Power Options
tweaks.description: Power plans and their advanced settings.

tweaks.title: Mouse settings
tweaks.description: Classic mouse properties (buttons, pointer).

tweaks.title: Sound settings
tweaks.description: Playback and recording devices, audio formats.

tweaks.title: Game Mode settings
tweaks.description: Turn Game Mode and capture on or off.

tweaks.title: Display refresh rate
tweaks.description: Make sure your monitor is running at its highest Hz.

tweaks.title: Windows Update
tweaks.description: Check for updates and set active hours.

tweaks.title: Network status
tweaks.description: Connection details, IP addresses and DNS.

tweaks.title: NVIDIA drivers
tweaks.description: Opens the download page for the latest drivers.

tweaks.title: AMD drivers
tweaks.description: Opens the AMD driver download page.

tweaks.title: My PC specs
tweaks.description: Reads the CPU, graphics card with driver version and Hz, RAM and Windows version.

tweaks.title: Power plan: Ultimate Performance
tweaks.description: A hidden Windows plan with no power saving: the shortest CPU response times. Biggest gain on laptops and PCs left on the Balanced plan; on AC power.
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures, shorter battery life.

tweaks.title: Turn off Core isolation (VBS / Memory integrity)
tweaks.description: The security feature with the biggest FPS cost: in CPU-bound games it can cost several to over ten percent. Lowers protection against malicious drivers. May not work if VBS is locked in UEFI or by company policy.
tweaks.consequences: Lowers protection against malicious drivers (Core isolation / Memory integrity). May not work if VBS is enforced by policy.

tweaks.title: Block Game DVR with system policies
tweaks.description: Reinforces the Game DVR shutdown: background recording won't turn back on even after an update.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Edge: no startup boost or background run
tweaks.description: Edge doesn't stay in memory after closing and doesn't load at Windows startup. Saves RAM and CPU while you play.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Chrome: no background run after closing
tweaks.description: Chrome doesn't leave background processes running after you close its window.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Windowed game optimizations + VRR
tweaks.description: Turns on "Optimizations for windowed games" and variable refresh rate. Lower latency in borderless mode.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Power Throttling
tweaks.description: Windows doesn't throttle "background" processes to save power (important on hybrid CPUs and laptops).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Processor performance preference (EPP = 0)
tweaks.description: A CPU with HWP aims for maximum performance instead of saving power (AC power).
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Turn off CPU idle states (C-states)
tweaks.description: Cores don't sleep, so response is instant. Much higher temperature and power draw; only for well-cooled desktop PCs.
tweaks.consequences: Higher power draw and temperatures; applies on AC power.

tweaks.title: Keep the kernel in RAM
tweaks.description: Disables paging of kernel code (DisablePagingExecutive). Makes sense with 16 GB of RAM or more.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Prefetch and Superfetch (SSD)
tweaks.description: On SSDs, preload files are unnecessary and only cause extra writes. Don't enable on an HDD.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Fast Startup (hybrid)
tweaks.description: Full shutdown and a clean start of the kernel and drivers. Eliminates "stuck" states after many days of uptime; startup may be slightly slower.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Less resources reserved for multimedia (MMCSS)
tweaks.description: Reserves 10% of CPU for background multimedia work instead of the default 20%. 0 is not used: Windows treats very low values unpredictably.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Faster system and app shutdown
tweaks.description: Cuts the wait for hung services and programs during shutdown to 2 s.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Auto-end unresponsive programs at sign-out
tweaks.description: Instead of the "this program is not responding" dialog, Windows simply closes them.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: No delay for startup apps
tweaks.description: Startup programs launch right after sign-in instead of after about 10 s.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: No automatic restarts after updates
tweaks.description: Windows won't restart your PC during a game while you're signed in (after updates).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Fortnite: high process and disk priority
tweaks.description: Windows runs the game with high CPU and I/O priority (process PerfOptions). Applies only to FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Hibernation (frees several GB of disk)
tweaks.description: Deletes hiberfil.sys (usually 40–75% of RAM size). Fast Startup will stop working.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a system setting via a command-line tool; the previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: NTFS: no last-access time updates
tweaks.description: The file system doesn't update timestamps on every read, which reduces the number of writes.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a system setting via a command-line tool; the previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Defender: low-priority scanning
tweaks.description: Lower CPU load during background scans (20% limit instead of 50%). Protection stays on.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a system setting via a command-line tool; the previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Turn off memory compression
tweaks.description: Less CPU work for memory management. Only for PCs with 16 GB of RAM or more.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a system setting via a command-line tool; the previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Turn off app prelaunch
tweaks.description: Windows doesn't preload frequently used apps into memory.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a system setting via a command-line tool; the previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Turn off Widgets (system policy)
tweaks.description: Fully disables the Widgets and news feed processes, which saves memory.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Block UWP apps from running in the background (policy)
tweaks.description: Forces background apps off for all users.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off dynamic system tick
tweaks.description: bcdedit: disabledynamictick. A constant system clock rate; reduces jitter and increases power draw. The effect depends on the hardware.
tweaks.consequences: Changes boot configuration; requires a restart. The effect depends on the hardware and may be none.

tweaks.title: Force platform clock (useplatformtick)
tweaks.description: Uses the platform clock instead of TSC for timer interrupts. The effect depends on the motherboard.
tweaks.consequences: Changes boot configuration; requires a restart. The effect depends on the hardware and may be none.

tweaks.title: Turn off hypervisor (Hyper-V) at startup
tweaks.description: Turns off the virtualization layer, so VBS and Hyper-V don't slow the system. WSL2, Docker and Hyper-V virtual machines will stop working.
tweaks.consequences: WSL2, Docker, Hyper-V, Windows Sandbox and some virtualization-based security features stop working.

tweaks.title: Turn off startup logo animation
tweaks.description: Skips the loading animation at system startup.
tweaks.consequences: Changes boot configuration; requires a restart. The effect depends on the hardware and may be none.

tweaks.title: Don't sleep USB, HID and network devices
tweaks.description: Turns off "Allow the computer to turn off this device", so your mouse, keyboard and network adapter never wake up late.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a system setting via a command-line tool; the previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Turn off keyboard layout shortcut
tweaks.description: Alt+Shift and Ctrl+Shift no longer switch the language during a game (a common cause of "stuck" keys).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off "Title bar window shake"
tweaks.description: Quickly shaking a held window with the mouse doesn't minimize other windows.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows Ink Workspace
tweaks.description: No Windows Ink icon or processes.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off pointer trails
tweaks.description: No cursor trail effect.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off typing suggestions and autocorrect
tweaks.description: Less processing while typing (touch keyboard suggestions).
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Priority 42 for foreground app
tweaks.description: An alternative Win32PrioritySeparation value (0x2A) favored by some gamers: shorter, fixed time slices. Value 38 is a separate option; enable only one.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value. The previous value is saved and restored when you undo.

tweaks.title: NIC: disable interrupt moderation
tweaks.description: The adapter reports packets immediately instead of batching them: lower latency at the cost of a little CPU. Briefly interrupts the connection (adapter restart).
tweaks.consequences: More interrupts: higher CPU use and lower throughput on gigabit and faster links on some adapters. The adapter restarts briefly.

tweaks.title: NIC: disable Energy-Efficient Ethernet
tweaks.description: Eliminates link micro-sleeps that can cause ping spikes. Briefly interrupts the connection (adapter restart).
tweaks.consequences: Changes the adapter driver settings. The connection drops briefly, and not every adapter supports this.

tweaks.title: NIC: disable Flow Control
tweaks.description: The adapter does not pause traffic on switch request, which reduces congestion. Briefly interrupts the connection (adapter restart).
tweaks.consequences: Changes the adapter driver settings. The connection drops briefly, and not every adapter supports this.

tweaks.title: NIC: disable Large Send Offload
tweaks.description: The CPU segments packets instead of the adapter; can be more stable in games. Briefly interrupts the connection (adapter restart).
tweaks.consequences: The CPU segments packets, which can lower upload throughput and raise CPU use. The adapter restarts briefly.

tweaks.title: NIC: disable Wake-on-LAN
tweaks.description: The adapter ignores wake-up packets, so fewer features run in the background. Briefly interrupts the connection (adapter restart).
tweaks.consequences: Changes the adapter driver settings. The connection drops briefly, and not every adapter supports this.

tweaks.title: Immediate ACKs (TcpDelAckTicks)
tweaks.description: Disables delayed TCP acknowledgments on active adapters. Affects TCP only; Fortnite mainly uses UDP.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value. The previous value is saved and restored when you undo.

tweaks.title: More ports, shorter TIME_WAIT
tweaks.description: MaxUserPort = 65534 and TcpTimedWaitDelay = 30 s: fewer problems with many parallel connections.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value. The previous value is saved and restored when you undo.

tweaks.title: DNS: don't cache failed lookups
tweaks.description: MaxNegativeCacheTtl = 0: Windows never remembers that a DNS name or record does not exist. Mostly useless: it only helps right after a short DNS outage.
tweaks.consequences: Every missing record (for example AAAA answers) is asked again on each connection, which adds DNS round trips and can make pages load slower. Revert if browsing feels slow.

tweaks.title: Disable TCP task offload (global)
tweaks.description: DisableTaskOffload = 1 turns off checksum and segmentation offload for every adapter. Only useful to work around a faulty network driver.
tweaks.consequences: The CPU must do all packet work, which lowers throughput on fast links and raises CPU use. If downloads got slower, revert this first.

tweaks.title: TCP: disable Receive Segment Coalescing
tweaks.description: Packets are not merged before being passed to the system, which lowers latency at the cost of CPU.
tweaks.consequences: Higher CPU use at high download speeds and possibly lower throughput. Revert if downloads got slower.

tweaks.title: TCP: disable timestamps
tweaks.description: Windows 10/11 already ship with TCP timestamps disabled, so this usually changes nothing.
tweaks.consequences: Usually no change. Undo returns the setting to the Windows default (disabled).

tweaks.title: TCP: disable receive window heuristics
tweaks.description: Windows no longer changes the receive window auto-tuning level on its own.
tweaks.consequences: Auto-tuning may stay at a level that does not suit your link, which can lower download speed. Revert if downloads got slower.

tweaks.title: Disable Teredo tunneling
tweaks.description: Less IPv6-over-IPv4 tunneling: no extra overhead or unnecessary traffic.
tweaks.consequences: Xbox networking and some peer-to-peer games use Teredo for NAT traversal; turning it off can worsen NAT type and break party chat or matchmaking.

tweaks.title: Disable 6to4 tunneling
tweaks.description: Turns off an obsolete IPv6 transition mechanism.
tweaks.consequences: Changes system settings via a command-line tool. The previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Disable ISATAP tunneling
tweaks.description: Turns off another obsolete IPv6 tunnel.
tweaks.consequences: Changes system settings via a command-line tool. The previous state is saved before the change.

tweaks.title: Turn off CPU vulnerability mitigations (Spectre / Meltdown)
tweaks.description: Disables the kernel workarounds for Spectre and Meltdown. On older Intel CPUs (before 10th gen) it can noticeably cut system-call and I/O overhead; on new CPUs the gain is small because the protection is in hardware.
tweaks.consequences: Lowers protection against side-channel attacks from malicious code running on your PC. Revert from History at any time. Needs a restart.

tweaks.title: Turn off memory page combining
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from scanning RAM for identical pages to merge. Saves a little background CPU and avoids occasional micro-stalls.
tweaks.consequences: Slightly higher RAM use on systems with many identical pages. Reversible.

tweaks.title: Instant window focus switching
tweaks.description: Sets the foreground lock timeout to 0 so a game or app that asks for focus gets it immediately instead of flashing in the taskbar.
tweaks.consequences: Other apps can steal focus more easily while you work. Reversible.

tweaks.title: Smaller mouse and keyboard input queues (contested)
tweaks.description: Lowers the driver data queue from 100 to 20 events. Community tests disagree on whether this changes anything you can measure, and it is a sensible choice only on a fast PC. Kept as an optional experiment; it is not part of any profile.
tweaks.consequences: Little or no measurable gain on most PCs. Very fast input bursts (macros, 8 kHz mice) can overflow the queue on a loaded system and drop events. Needs a restart. Reversible.

tweaks.title: Turn off Memory integrity (HVCI) only
tweaks.description: Disables hypervisor-enforced code integrity. In CPU-bound games it can recover several percent of FPS on systems where it is enabled.
tweaks.consequences: Drivers are no longer checked by the hypervisor, so malicious or vulnerable drivers are easier to load. Reversible; may be locked by UEFI or company policy.

tweaks.title: Enhanced TSC synchronization
tweaks.description: bcdedit: tscsyncpolicy Enhanced. Uses the most accurate multi-core time-stamp counter sync, which can reduce timer jitter on some boards.
tweaks.consequences: Changes boot configuration and needs a restart. The effect depends on the motherboard and may be none; revert restores the default.

tweaks.title: Turn off NTFS 8.3 short file names
tweaks.description: Stops creating legacy DOS-style short names for every new file. Less disk metadata work, mostly useful on folders with many files.
tweaks.consequences: Very old 16-bit programs may not see short names for new files. The previous setting is restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off Kernel-mode Hardware-enforced Stack Protection
tweaks.description: Disables the CET shadow-stack protection of the Windows kernel (Windows 11 22H2+, CPUs with CET). Removes a small per-call cost in the kernel and in drivers.
tweaks.consequences: Lowers protection against return-oriented attacks in kernel code. Needs a restart; ignored on PCs without CET support. Reversible.

tweaks.title: Turn off timer coalescing
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from batching timer wake-ups to save power. Timers fire on time instead of up to a few ms late, which can smooth frame pacing on some systems.
tweaks.consequences: Slightly higher idle power use. Reversible; needs a restart.

tweaks.description: Shows the keyboards Windows currently sees.

tweaks.title: List connected mice
tweaks.description: Shows the mice and pointing devices Windows currently sees.

tweaks.title: Check mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Reads your pointer settings and tells you whether acceleration (Enhance pointer precision) is on.
tweaks.target: $m = Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; 'Pointer speed (1-20): ' + $m.MouseSensitivity; 'Enhance pointer precision: ' + $(if ($m.MouseSpeed -eq '0') { 'OFF (best for aiming)' } else { 'ON' }); 'Acceleration thresholds: ' + $m.MouseThreshold1 + ' / ' + $m.MouseThreshold2

tweaks.title: Turn off USB 3 link power saving
tweaks.description: USB 3 ports do not drop into low-power link states, which avoids a wake-up delay on mice, keyboards and headsets (on AC power).
tweaks.consequences: Slightly higher power draw on AC power.

tweaks.title: Turn off AutoPlay
tweaks.description: Windows no longer starts programs from USB sticks and discs on its own.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Turn off clipboard history
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from keeping a history of what you copy.
tweaks.consequences: Changes a registry value; the previous value is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: Clear Visual Studio Code cache
tweaks.description: Deletes Cache, CachedData, Code Cache and GPUCache. Close VS Code before cleaning.
tweaks.confirm: Close Visual Studio Code before cleaning. Continue?

tweaks.title: Clear Microsoft Teams (classic) cache
tweaks.description: Deletes Cache, GPUCache, Code Cache and temporary files. Close Teams before cleaning.
tweaks.confirm: Close Microsoft Teams before cleaning. Continue?

tweaks.title: Network repair: restore TCP defaults
tweaks.description: Resets TCP auto-tuning, RSS and RSC to the Windows defaults and flushes DNS. Use it if the Internet got slower after tweaking. Also use "Undo all network tweaks" on the Network page.
tweaks.confirm: Reset TCP auto-tuning, RSS and RSC to the Windows defaults and flush the DNS cache?
tweaks.successMessage: TCP settings reset to the Windows defaults and DNS flushed.

tweaks.title: Merge service host processes
tweaks.description: SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB is raised so Windows stops splitting services into many separate svchost processes. Fewer processes and a little less RAM.
tweaks.consequences: If one service in a shared host crashes it can take its neighbours with it. Reversible; needs a restart.

tweaks.title: Turn off Fault Tolerant Heap
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from applying slow compatibility fixes to a program after it has crashed a few times.
tweaks.consequences: A program that keeps crashing is no longer silently patched by Windows and may crash more visibly. Reversible.

tweaks.title: Exact 1:1 mouse curve (100% scaling)
tweaks.description: Writes a perfectly linear pointer curve (SmoothMouseXCurve/YCurve) so no leftover acceleration data remains, even if Windows or a driver re-enables Enhance pointer precision. Made for 100% display scaling.
tweaks.consequences: On displays with scaling other than 100% the pointer can feel slightly faster or slower. Changes the pointer curve only; the previous curve is saved and restored on undo.

tweaks.title: High priority for the input process (csrss)
tweaks.description: Runs csrss.exe, the Windows process that routes mouse and keyboard input to your game, at High CPU priority. Helps input stay responsive when the CPU is fully loaded.
tweaks.consequences: WARNING: raises the priority of a core system process. Safe on normal PCs, but if the system feels unresponsive after a restart, undo it from History. Needs a restart.
